versions.changelog: Align the ClawHub bundle with the GitHub v2 source and fix ShellCheck max-token validation.
Portable Claude/Codex/OpenClaw release; adds async ASR/TTS, Word/PDF translation, hardened Bash clients, risk-based privacy and cost controls, MONGOL_AI_SKILL_API_KEY migration, tests, and CI.
Security audit response: localize billing disclosure only when explicitly requested and replace the task-specific default prompt with a neutral Mongolian-language task prompt.
